notes: Research only. No production writes, live orders, or automatic promotion.
This is a newly reserved retrospective suffix, NOT untouched by all prior project research. Prospective shadow evidence is still required.
Fees, penetration and partial fills are hypothetical sensitivity assumptions, not calibrated venue costs or fill probabilities.
5 bp is a predeclared materiality requirement, not an assumed parameter-switching fee. Switching fee is zero.
Buy is a quote-currency budget task; sell is a fixed-inventory task of matching initial notional. Their scores are not interchangeable.
Daily reset assumes all prior passive orders have been cancelled before new orders. Reservations are tested separately.
Finish mode starts with 60% weekly target and 100% remaining to a same-week deadline; both remaining inputs decrease only on fills.
Finish mode models an explicit aggressive completion intervention 15 minutes before close for BOTH sides. This is not currently an automatic page or broker action.
Price-seeking residual is valued at the next session reference for opportunity-cost accounting, not called a passive fill.
ETF prices are indexed spot proxies anchored to registry convenience prices at the start of the dataset, not historical ETF quotes.
Current registry filters are held constant; historical exchange rule changes and archive publication delays are not reconstructed.
No strategy is promoted by this runner, even if its provisional statistical checks pass. Independent data, live-policy parity and prospective validation are separate gates.
